project.era_setting: present day, a northern harbour town

script.title: The Last Crossing
script.logline: Forty years late, a woman catches the last ferry to return a locket to the man who gave it to her.

scenes.heading: EXT. HARBOUR PIER - DUSK
scenes.text:
Wind whips sea spray across a deserted wooden pier.

MARA (60s), wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket, hurries down the planks clutching a brass locket.

MARA
(breathless)
Wait. Please wait.
scenes.purpose: Mara races to catch the last ferry.

scenes.heading: INT. FERRY CABIN - NIGHT
scenes.text:
Warm tungsten light. Rows of empty benches. JONAS (60s), broad-shouldered, flat cap, sits alone by a spray-streaked window.

Mara stops in the doorway. She opens her hand: the locket. Jonas takes it, opens it, and smiles.

MARA
Forty years. You're late.

scenes.heading: EXT. HARBOUR PIER - NIGHT
scenes.text:
The pier is empty now, its lamps dark. An old lantern flickers on the wet planks.

MARA (V.O.)
You always were late.
